items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I think the only staff musicians on that show was Specs Powell and myself.

ctx.x: So I have gotten into fights and I don't mind getting into fights about things. I don't think it does any good but sometimes it just makes me mad. But truthfully, I had this
incident, I don't know if you heard about it, when we were doing the Mildred Bailey Show. We had Charlie Shavers, Teddy Wilson, Al Hall, Specs Powell and Trummy Young.
